import builtins
app.actions.run('sim.reset')
builtins.si_until_tick(0)
app.demos.record(True)
builtins.si_frames(4)
for a, b, c in [(0.6, 0.4, -1.0), (-0.5, -0.3, -0.4), (0.9, 0.7, -1.6), (0.0, 0.1, -0.2), (-0.8, -0.6, -1.2), (0.3, 0.2, -0.7)]:
    app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={'shoulder_yaw': a, 'shoulder_pitch': b, 'elbow': c})
    builtins.si_frames(2)
    builtins.si_step(40)
s = app.demos.record(False)
assert len(s['episodes']) == 1 and s['episodes'][0]['steps'] == 240, s['episodes']
d = builtins.si_damping(1.2)
assert all(abs(v - 1.2) < 1e-6 for v in d.values()), d

import builtins
f = builtins.si_fails
all3 = [{'param': 'joint_damping'}]
f('sysid.run', 'lists no parameter', params=[])
f('sysid.run', "'bogus' is not joint_damping", params=[{'param': 'bogus'}])
f('sysid.run', "the demonstrations have no joint 'nope'", params=[{'param': 'joint_damping', 'joints': ['nope']}])
f('sysid.run', 'wants a finite min below its max', params=[{'param': 'joint_damping', 'min': 2.0, 'max': 1.0}])
f('sysid.run', 'a mass scale stays above 0', params=[{'param': 'link_mass_scale', 'min': 0.0}])
f('sysid.run', 'has no live joint.frictionloss', params=[{'param': 'joint_frictionloss', 'max': 1.0}])
f('sysid.run', 'the episode is one of 0..0', episode=3, params=all3)
f('sysid.run', 'the population is 2..256', population=1, params=all3)
f('sysid.run', 'the generations are 1..1000', generations=0, params=all3)
f('sysid.run', 'sigma is in (0, 1]', sigma=2.0, params=all3)
f('sysid.stop', '')
f('sysid.apply', '')
r = app.actions.run('sysid.run', params=[{'param': 'link_mass_scale', 'joints': ['elbow']}, {'param': 'joint_armature', 'max': 0.05}], generations=50, population=6)
assert r == {'episode': 0, 'steps': 240, 'params': 2, 'evaluations': 301}, r
f('sysid.run', 'an identification is running', params=all3)
builtins.si_frames(6)
s = app.actions.run('sysid.stop')
print('SYSID_STOP', {k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != 'curve'})
assert not s['running'] and s['error'] is None and s['generations'] == 50 and s['population'] == 6, s
assert [p['param'] for p in s['params']] == ['link_mass_scale', 'joint_armature'], s['params']
assert s['params'][0]['nominal'] == 1.0 and s['params'][0]['joints'] == ['elbow'], s['params']
assert s['evaluations'] < 301 and s['generation'] < 50, s
builtins.si_frames(10)
assert not app.actions.run('sysid.status')['running']

import builtins
r = app.actions.run('sysid.run', params=[{'param': 'joint_damping', 'min': 0.2, 'max': 2.0}], generations=15, population=8, seed=3)
print('SYSID_RUN', r)
assert r == {'episode': 0, 'steps': 240, 'params': 1, 'evaluations': 121}, r
s = builtins.si_finish(240.0)
print('SYSID_DONE', {k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != 'curve'}, s['curve'][-3:])
p = s['params'][0]
assert s['error'] is None and s['generation'] >= 1 and s['evaluations'] <= 121 and s['steps'] == 240, s
assert p['joints'] == ['shoulder_yaw', 'shoulder_pitch', 'elbow'] and abs(p['nominal'] - 1.2) < 1e-5, p
assert abs(p['value'] - 0.8) < 0.08, p
assert s['best_loss'] < 0.05 * s['start_loss'], (s['start_loss'], s['best_loss'])
assert all(a >= b for a, b in zip(s['curve'], s['curve'][1:])), s['curve']

import builtins
value = app.actions.run('sysid.status')['params'][0]['value']
app.actions.run('sysid.apply')
builtins.si_frames(4)
j = {x['name']: x['damping'] for x in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints']}
print('SYSID_APPLY', value, j)
assert all(abs(d - value) < 1e-4 for d in j.values()), (j, value)
app.actions.run('edit.undo')
builtins.si_frames(4)
j = {x['name']: x['damping'] for x in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints']}
assert all(abs(d - 1.2) < 1e-5 for d in j.values()), j
